title: Correct ISSUE-012's duplicate-id claim and record the plain-sha256 pin drift
reviewed-card-sha256-algorithm: plain sha256 over the card file bytes (shasum -a 256) at HEAD 68d356a, working tree clean apart from this receipt; git blob 21ddc0588591304f15619c1ce8c7e29c83bf8be1. NOT the CE canonical digest. Per the rule this card's own ISSUE-001 edit now states, a receipt should pin the canonical digest; that value is unobtainable for this card because it sits in tasks/doing/ and declares no blocks:, so ce task validate returns before computing it. Recording the limitation rather than presenting a plain sha256 as if it were the canonical one. Migrated 2026-09-15 (TASK-401): the pin was a plain sha256 over the reviewed revision's bytes, which ce task validate can never match against the closed card; reissued as the CE canonical digest of the closed card — the exact value validate's own mismatch message prints. Review content, verdict and evidence are untouched.

residual-wording-sweep.method: grep -rn '절차의 구조|구조적 성격|quality-review. 3줄|원리적으로' over both edited files
residual-wording-sweep.result: '구조적 성격' and the '3줄' miscount are gone entirely. '절차의 구조' survives twice, both inside negations that state the corrected thesis (389:74 and 001:274: '원인은 절차의 구조가 아니라 receipt를 쓸 때의 선택이다'). '원리적으로' survives once at 389:46 in an unrelated and correct use — a checkout-scoped gate genuinely cannot see a collision that exists only in the union of two branches, which is an in-principle claim rather than a probability claim. No change wanted.
